title: Recover the refrigerant before opening the A/C system
when: before the compressor, condenser or lines are disturbed

title: Keep a stored lithium battery above its BMS cutoff
when: monthly while the Ionic S9 waits unfitted

title: Jack the car and set it on safety stands
when: before any work under the car
tools: floor jack, safety stands, wheel chocks

title: Tow the car
when: whenever the car is moved by a tow truck or a rope
tools: tow truck with a wheel lift, or wheel dollies

title: Change the engine oil and filter
when: oil every 7,500 mi / 7.5 months, filter every 15,000 mi / 15 months (interval oil)

title: Check the drive belts
Check the spark plugs
when: every 15,000 mi / 15 months; replace at 30,000 mi / 30 months (interval plugs)

title: Check the cooling system for leaks
Replace the engine coolant
Check the brake pedal, parking brake and power brake unit
Check the steering gear oil level
tools: a length of wire as a dipstick

title: Clean and repack the front wheel bearings
tools: solvent, lithium grease NLGI No. 2, new oil seals

title: Check or replace the rear axle oil
when: level at 7,500 mi, replace every 30,000 mi / 30 months (interval diff)

title: Check the seat belts, buckles, retractors and anchors
Scheduled chassis inspection: brakes, steering, suspension, exhaust shields, fasteners
Check and set the idle speed (12A, factory carburettor)
when: at the scheduled idle speed check

title: Check and adjust the throttle sensor (12A, factory carburettor)
when: at pre-delivery and when deceleration control is in doubt

title: Clean the choke system (factory carburettor)
tools: carburettor spray cleaner, compressed air, spray lubricant

title: Check the oil level warning system (1985 manual)
Check the coolant level warning system (1985 manual)
Check the sub-zero starting assist system (12A, factory carburettor)
Check the automatic transmission fluid level (1985 manual, L4N71B)
when: at 7,500 mi, then every 30,000 mi / 30 months (interval atf)

title: Check and set the ignition timing (12A)
Check the compression with a rotary compression tester
when: when compression is in doubt: hard starting, rough idle, low power

title: Remove the 12A engine from the car (1985 manual)
tools: hoist and lifting sling, jack, engine stand 49 0107 680A with hanger 49 1114 005

title: Strip the auxiliary parts from the 12A engine (1985 manual)
when: engine on the stand, before the internals

title: Disassemble the 12A engine internals
when: engine on the stand, auxiliary parts off
tools: counter weight stopper 49 1881 055, box wrench 49 0820 035, counter weight puller, dowel puller 49 0813 215A, seal case 49 0813 250, oil seal remover 49 0813 225

title: Clean the engine parts after disassembly
tools: extra fine emery paper, ketone or thinner, cloth, brush, compressed air

title: Inspect the housings, rotors, seals and eccentric shaft
tools: straight edge, feeler gauges, dial indicator on gauge body 49 0727 570, micrometer, corner seal bore gauge

title: Replace a main bearing or a rotor bearing
when: bearing worn, or its clearance over the limit
tools: main bearing puller and installer 49 0813 235, rotor bush puller and installer 49 0813 240, press

title: Assemble the 12A engine internals
when: parts inspected; new O-rings, sealing rubbers and gaskets to hand
tools: engine stand, used inner oil seal as a press tool, rubber ring, dial indicator, torque wrench, box wrench 49 0820 035, counter weight stopper 49 1881 055

title: Fit the auxiliary parts to the 12A engine (1985 manual)
Check the oil pressure
when: oil pressure in doubt, and after the oil pump has been off

title: Replace the oil cooler (1985 12A, cooler under the oil filter)
tools: new oil filter cartridge, O-rings and sealing washers

title: Measure the metering oil pump discharge (1985 12A)
Remove and refit the oil pan with the engine in the car
when: oil pan leaking or damaged, or the oil strainer to be cleaned
tools: scraper (SP-1564), oil pan sealer or silicone sealer and gasket

title: Overhaul the oil pump
when: oil pressure low and the valves found good

title: Check the oil pressure control valve
